verdict.rationale: CSC's own platform runs some fixed automations in the background. The Compliance Calendar automatically creates filing events and sends email reminders to unlimited users. Corporate Tracker emails alerts on good-standing or name changes. AI handles automated entity and folder routing for bulk document imports, and SOP is delivered according to user routing preferences. These are pre-built automations with limited configuration, not a user-defined automation or agentic workflow builder. Missing for 10: user-configurable triggers/actions or a workflow builder, autonomous AI agent execution, documentation of how users set up or customize automations, independent corroboration.
